Extract from Straits Settlements Police Political
Intelligence Journal, dated November 30, 1934.

57. Ruttner, Josef.

Austrian Jew - born Vienna, 11th February, 1900.
Suspected to have Communist sympathies. Arrested,
Miri, Sarawak as a destitute and deported from Singapore
to Trieste by s.s. "Col di Lana" on 21st August, 1934.
He "jumped ship" at Marmagoa and arrived in Bombay by
train on 6th September, 1934.
He was arrested on 10th September, 1934, and showed
violence and assaulted the Police. He was sentenced
to nine months' R.I. in Bombay on 25th October, 1934.
He should not be allowed to re-enter the Colony.
The name and address of Ernst Gruinfeld (Para. 55
above) in Calcutta and in Vienna appear amongst his papers.

S.B. Res.

57. 鲁特纳，约瑟夫（Ruttner, Josef）。

奥地利犹太人——1900年2月11日生于维也纳。
涉嫌具有共产主义同情倾向。作为赤贫者于砂拉越美里（Miri, Sarawak）被捕，并于1934年8月21日由“科迪拉纳”号（s.s. "Col di Lana"）轮船从新加坡遣往特里雅斯特。他在马尔马戈阿（Marmagoa）“跳船”，并于1934年9月6日乘火车抵达孟买。
他于1934年9月10日被捕，期间施暴并袭击警察。1934年10月25日，他在孟买被判处九个月严加监禁（R.I.）。
不应允许其重新进入该殖民地。
其文件中出现了恩斯特·格林菲尔德（Ernst Gruinfeld）（见上文第55段）在加尔各答和维也纳的姓名及地址。

特别股决议。

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by [签名] D.I.

x See file
D.6811

Harold Sidney Peake, aged 37, born at Harrow, England, in the year 1897, came to Shanghai in 1924 to fulfill a contract with the Shanghai Telephone Company where he was to be employed as an accountant. He stayed with the Telephone Company until about the beginning of 1932 when he left and joined Honigsberg and Company (now the Cathay Motors), the offices of which are at Medhurst and Avenue Roads corner. On December 12, 1932, Peake was married in Yokohama to Isabel Maria Wortman, a divorcee. The marriage was performed by the Mayor of Yokohama and constituted a civil marriage. Isabel Maria Wortman's former husband is believed to have been an Austrian. Her father Fernandi Augusti Y Pastor, is a Spaniard and was in the Spanish Army during the Spanish American War and, according to information at hand, was in Manila at the time of his daughter's marriage to Peake. A further marriage ceremony was performed at the H.B.M. Consulate Shanghai on February 23, 1933.

With the formation of the Cathay Motors Company from the Honigsberg and Company control passed into Chinese hands and Peake is reputed to have put $10,000 into the new business, this was in July or August 1933. In February 1934 Peake severed his connection with the Cathay Motors and was allowed to withdraw his capital plus a certain per cent as interest or bonus. He next became connected with the Purity Water Company as a director but did not serve the company long and is now with White and Company bullion brokers as an accountant.

With reference to the attached letter signed by Harold S. Peake (Document (6) SB 2223) found in Josef Ruttner's possession in Singapore, information obtained as the result of enquiries indicates that Josef Ruttner was known to Peake's wife and that it was she who persuaded Peake to assist Ruttner. 哈罗德·西德尼·皮克，37岁，1897年生于英格兰哈罗（Harrow），于1924年来到上海，履行与上海电话公司签订的合同，受聘担任会计师。他在电话公司工作至1932年初左右，随后离职加入霍尼格斯伯格公司（Honigsberg and Company，即现在的国泰汽车公司 Cathay Motors），其办事处位于麦赫斯特路（Medhurst Road）与大西路（Avenue Road）转角处。1932年12月12日，皮克在横滨与离异人士伊莎贝尔·玛丽亚·沃特曼（Isabel Maria Wortman）结婚。婚礼由横滨市长主持，属民事婚姻。据信伊莎贝尔·玛丽亚·沃特曼的前夫是奥地利人。她的父亲费尔南迪·奥古斯蒂·帕斯托尔（Fernandi Augusti Y Pastor）是西班牙人，曾在美西战争期间服役于西班牙军队，根据现有资料，在其女儿与皮克结婚时，他身在马尼拉。1933年2月23日，两人在英国驻上海总领事馆再次举行了婚礼仪式。

随着国泰汽车公司从霍尼格斯伯格公司手中成立，控制权转入中国人手中，据称皮克向新业务投入了10,000美元，此事发生在1933年7月或8月。1934年2月，皮克断绝了与国泰汽车公司的关系，并被允许撤回其本金加上一定百分比的利息或红利。他随后以董事身份与纯水公司（Purity Water Company）建立联系，但并未在公司服务太久，目前在怀特公司（White and Company）金银经纪行担任会计师。

关于在新加坡约瑟夫·鲁特纳身上发现的由哈罗德·S·皮克签名的附件信件（文件 (6) SB 2223），调查显示，鲁特纳为皮克的妻子所认识，且正是她说服皮克协助鲁特纳。目前尚不清楚

My dear Steptoe,

With reference to your letter of October 22
requesting that enquiries be made about two documents
found in possession of an Austrian Jew named Josef
Ruttner, of which you enclosed photographs, I have to
state that enquiries show that the signatures on both
documents are genuine. The assertion in the Document
No. (5)SB2223 is correct. The statement in the Document
No. (6)SB2223 is false. Peake by whom Document No.(6)SB2223
was signed, worked in the Cathay Motors from August 1933
to February 1934, but Ruttner was never employed there.
Peake probably was influenced to sign the recommendation
by a woman named Sophia Szambelanowna alias Szambelan alias
Barbara Barber, of whom he is known to have been a close
associate. Sophia Szambelanowna is believed to be
either a Soviet or Communist agent.

August 26, 1933 and resided at a boarding house at No.20
Chusan Road. He applied to the local Netherlands Consulate
in November of the same year for permission to visit
the Netherlands East Indies, but his application was refused.
He left for Hongkong on January 22, 1934.

I return herewith the photograph of Ruttner and
the photographs of the documents found in his possession
which were enclosed in your letter.

Made by D.S. Sansom Forwarded by [Signature] S.I.

With reference to the observation contained in the attached
letter from the British Consulate-General on the genuineness of two
photographic copies of documents possessed by Josef RUTTNER, I have
to state that one of them - (6.SB2223), a testimonial dated 14/1/34
and signed "H.S. PEAKE", business manager, giving out that Ruttner
had been employed by Cathay Motors for a period of 6 months - has
been falsified.

It is a certainty that Ruttner was not at any time employed
by Cathay Motors; nevertheless the signature to the testimonial is
unmistakably genuine.

Cathay Motors came into existence during August 1933 and
Peake was employed as business manager until February 1934, when
he resigned. A stenographer was employed under him, but the
typographical errors in the document suggest that Peake did the
typing himself.

The conclusion that Peake is responsible for a wilful
misrepresentation on behalf of a political suspect is strengthened
by his (Peake's) association with a Soviet Secret Agent named
"Miss Sophia SZAMBELANOWNA alias SZAMBELAN alias Barbara BARBER,
a casual reference to same being contained in a report on the
latter, dated 30/7/34.

The second document in question - (5.SB2223), a letter
from the Austrian Consul confirming Ruttner's nationality - is
genuine.

Ruttner arrived in Shanghai from Calcutta on the 26/8/33
and apparently left for Hongkong on the 22/1/34, having resided
at a boarding-house, 20 Chusan Road, in the interim.

SHANGHAI, 30th November 1933

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the Austrian citizen
Joseph RUTTNER, an engineer, born at Puchberg, Austria, 11
February 1900, living at Chusan Road 20, c.o.Futere, intends
to proceed to Netherlands India. He is in the possession of an
Austrian passport, issued by the Austrian Consulate General at
New York on 21 June 1929 and extended at Calcutta on 20 June
1933 until 20 June 1935. The present passport was issued to
him against an old passport no.1050 issued on 14 February 1923
by the Austrian Legation at Bucarest. On the present passport
he has travelled through the Central and South American States,
Europe, Turkey, Persia, British India, Burma, Siam, Indo-China,
arriving in Shanghai at the end of August of this year. A let-
ter of recommendation was given to him by the local Austrian
Consulate on 31 August 1933, no.302/A, stating that he had good
testimonials as a chief mechanic in Columbia and South America.

Mr.RUTTNER declared that he was not looking for work,
but that he intended to visit New Guinea and the Minor Soenda
Islands for the purpose of study, making films and writing
articles. He stated not to be connected with any special paper
and to dispose of sufficient funds to pay for his expenses.
During his stay in Shanghai he said that he had not been em-
ployed, having no desire to obtain a position in China.

His address in Vienna is stated to be: Neulingstrasse 32.

I would be much obliged to be informed whether anything
is known against Mr.RUTTNER from a political or moral point of
view.

S2
4/2

T.P.Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

上海，1933年11月30日

先生，

荣幸地通知阁下，奥地利公民
Joseph RUTTNER，工程师，1900年2月11日出生于奥地利 Puchberg，
现居舟山路20号，c.o.Futere，打算前往荷属印度。他持有
一本奥地利护照，由奥地利驻纽约总领事馆于1929年6月21日签发，
并在加尔各答延期至1935年6月20日。现行护照是凭旧护照
（1923年2月14日由奥地利驻布加勒斯特公使馆签发的第1050号）
换发的。凭现行护照，他游历了中南美洲各国、欧洲、土耳其、波斯、
英属印度、缅甸、暹罗、印度支那，并于今年8月底抵达上海。
当地奥地利领事馆于1933年8月31日向他出具了一封推荐信，
编号302/A，称他在哥伦比亚和南美洲担任首席机械师时拥有良好的证明书。

RUTTNER 先生声明他不是在找工作，而是打算为了学习、拍摄电影
和撰写文章的目的访问新几内亚和小巽他群岛。他声称不与任何特定
报纸有关联，并有足够的资金支付费用。他说在上海逗留期间未曾受雇，
无意在中国谋取职位。

他在维也纳的地址据称为：Neulingstrasse 32。

如蒙告知从政治或道德角度是否了解有关 RUTTNER 先生的任何不良情况，
不胜感激。

S2
4/2

T.P.Givens 先生，
特科主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（批：M. Gurn / 12月31日）

谨此，
先生，
阁下顺从的仆人，
（签名）
华务秘书。
